scope: Champion enrichment batch 10C: original source-linked fight decisions with resource and matchup caveats; not independent gameplay verification.

decisions.title: Build self-Bleeds only to support an actual Fury conversion
decisions.text: Old Man Logan can accumulate self-Bleed passives through combat and refresh them with a safe Heavy. Check remaining regeneration and the current effect count instead of deliberately taking unsafe hits to accelerate damage.

decisions.title: Time a Special near the regeneration transition
decisions.text: A Special timed around regeneration can change some developed effects into Fury. Avoid throwing the Special too early or after recovery has already expired; the window affects whether the longer build is worth its cost.

decisions.title: Choose SP2 Bleed or SP1 when the opponent is immune
decisions.text: SP2 is useful against a Bleed-susceptible defender, while SP1 can be a practical alternative when Bleed is unavailable. Watch the Fury timer and consider whether another Heavy pause can be executed safely.

decisions.title: Build Resolve with safe Light hits before planning Reversal
decisions.text: Patriot's Light attacks and SP1 can build combo, Resolve and Physical Vulnerability. Read the current Resolve level before using a risky defensive counter, because a low-resource Reversal may not produce the intended damage opening.

decisions.title: Trigger Heavy Reversal only into an eligible basic attack
decisions.text: The charged-Heavy Reversal has a specific incoming-hit condition and is not blanket protection against Specials. Verify range and the opposing node before practicing the counter in a high-stakes fight.

decisions.title: Use SP2 as the defender stands after a genuine Reversal
decisions.text: A properly timed SP2 can benefit from Unblockable and a longer Fury or Precision window. If Reversal never triggered, do not assume the same follow-up buffs will be present.

decisions.title: Use non-ending basics to prepare a controlled Heavy aura
decisions.text: Phoenix's Heavy interaction can produce a passive Stun opportunity after the correct setup. Check whether the defender is eligible and in range before charging; a normal Heavy at neutral range is not automatically safe.

decisions.title: Build SP1 Fury only when the defender is Incinerated
decisions.text: SP1 can reward an Incinerated opponent with Fury. If the target is Incinerate-immune or the debuff has expired, the next Special should not be planned around a damage buff that was never granted.

decisions.title: Treat SP3 as a limited survival choice rather than passive immortality
decisions.text: SP2 can develop Phoenix Force and extend the offensive plan, whereas SP3 can serve a distinct survival or healing tradeoff. Track any once-per-fight charge and node healing restrictions before spending three bars.

decisions.title: Develop Precision before a Heavy Resonance cash-out
decisions.text: Phyla-Vell can gain Precision from safe combos and Dexterity triggers. Check the current buff state rather than assuming the first Heavy automatically delivers a fully ramped SP2.

decisions.title: Release a prepared Heavy for Resonance with adequate spacing
decisions.text: A Heavy can establish dormant Resonance while also changing power availability. Time the cancellation and attack after a real recovery; mistiming a charged Heavy can lose both the buff window and fight control.

decisions.title: Link second Heavy hit to SP2 only when the setup remains
decisions.text: The recorded sequence can cancel the second Heavy hit into SP2 with useful Precision and Resonance. Check the defender's protections and your current power first, rather than treating the high-damage sequence as unconditional.

decisions.title: Read the active cards before choosing a Special
decisions.text: Platinum Pool's card effects can change the useful route from one fight to another. Inspect the current hand and available buffs; a memorized rotation may not perform identically when a different card is drawn.

decisions.title: Establish Bleed before trying for the SP2 dance
decisions.text: SP1 can create Bleed pressure maintained by eligible basic hits. A Bleed-immune defender or a prematurely expired debuff can remove the setup needed for the more rewarding SP2 outcome.

decisions.title: Complete the SP2 interaction only when Stun is allowed
decisions.text: SP2 can support a Stun-assisted dance and card draw, while SP3 can redraw. Check the defender's Stun immunity and remaining health before choosing a two-bar setup that may be impossible to complete.
